report.summary: Patient P-D006 (age 59, uninsured/self-pay, no transport benefit) screened positive for a transportation barrier and faces a high $420/month copay for brand tiotropium (45-day refill gap). Home tract 17031290900: 41% of households no vehicle, low-income area. Upcoming clinic appointment appt:2 on 2026-10-23 at 14:00; facility location not on file so transit feasibility could not be computed. Patient mentioned the Pulaski bus route serves the destination. Eligibility: Medicaid Ride Line NOT eligible (uninsured); Senior Shuttle West NOT eligible (age 59, requires 60+); Paratransit requires ADA certification with up to 21-day decision (appointment is 14 days out—tight). Med-cost programs likely eligible: Clinic Rx Fund (current patient, short-term copay help), Rx Bridge Program (chronic illness), Community Pharmacy Assistance (Extra Help/manufacturer program applications).

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Short-term copay assistance for current patients; ask clinic social work/financial counselor to apply.

options.name: Rx Bridge Program
options.how_to_access: Free and low-cost medication options for people with chronic illness; apply to cover brand tiotropium.

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Help applying for Extra Help and manufacturer patient-assistance programs.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days (appointment 10/23 is 14 days away—start immediately).

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members only—call number on card 2+ business days ahead. Patient is uninsured, so NOT eligible.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West
options.how_to_access: Free rides 60+ to medical appointments weekdays 7 AM–5 PM. Patient is 59, so NOT eligible.
